direct_gate: First run 4 official stove starts and the original drawer start 1 before drawer manipulation. Use two seeds in each of two freshly loaded policy blocks. At least one path in each family must show switch contact and the native on predicate at the full deadline before running paired continuations. Report all paths and layouts.
transfer: Use the official stove BDDL throughout. For A/B replay every archived drawer command from public drawer start 1. Validate old drawer contacts, joints, open predicate and archived physics digests. Switch the language and continue in the same live simulation without resetting the robot, objects or controller.
keys: Direct public trials start at their native seed. Matched drawer-start controls and all continuation arms start with the native key after 32 splits of each seed. Seed 0 must equal the archived RNG after the 160-control donor. Other seeds vary only future sampling.
primary: At switch 160 compare A (no final drawer contact) and B (final contact) at identical budgets and paired seeds. Primary outcome is native switch-on at subsequent control 160. Also record at 300, time of first on, last drawer contact, first gripper contact with any stove part and with the moving button.
timing: Using the same A/B tapes include switch 155 (only B touching), 156 and 159 (neither touching). Each receives identical fresh post-switch control budgets and the same key offset. These are timing controls from one drawer layout; the complete arm/robot/object states co-vary with contact.
readout: Sample MuJoCo contact pairs at each control boundary. Include switch step zero when reporting last drawer contact and report strictly post-switch contact separately. Keep physical paths to 300 even upon early success. Compare paired seeds; technical repeats do not increase the number of independent endpoints.
fixed_command_control: After the closed-loop trials, execute each switch-160 A command tape from B and each B tape from A, for all eight paired sampler seeds and both blocks. Keep all 300 native actuator commands fixed. Use the original physical replay as the same-state control. Score the same predicates and times; cross-replay tests portability of an open-loop command tape.
